Effects on the endocrine system. Amenorrhoea has been reported1,2 in women taking thalidomide for severe dermatolog- ical conditions; menses resumed 2 to 3 months after stopping thalidomide.2 Hypothyroidism has been associated with thalidomide use in pa- tients with multiple myeloma,3,4 and it was suggested3 that some adverse effects of thalidomide, such as bradycardia and constipa- tion, may be manifestations of hypothyroidism. Severe hyperglycaemia has been reported5 in a 70-year-old man 4 weeks after starting thalidomide for multiple myeloma.
